name: ash-vscode
description: Runs the ash CLI over the open workspace and reports its SARIF findings as editor diagnostics. Ships no scanners and no copy of ASH.

ash.executablePath.markdownDescription: The ASH executable to run. `ash` resolves through PATH. On Windows with MSYS2 or Git Bash on PATH, a bare `ash` can resolve to the Almquist shell instead of ASH; set this to `automated-security-helper`, which ASH installs as a permanent alias for exactly that case.

ash.outputDirectory.description: Directory the scan writes to, relative to the workspace folder. ASH writes its SARIF report to reports/ash.sarif underneath it.

ash.extraArguments.markdownDescription: Extra arguments appended to `ash scan`, for example `--scanners detect-secrets` or `--offline`.
